hypotheses.reasoning: At 13:32:33 notification-svc reloaded config revision 485, which changed TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to http://template-svc.internal:9090. Calls to template-svc were succeeding until about 13:32:36 (#1003, #1007). From 13:33:04 onward, every TemplateClient.render from notification-svc fails with connect ECONNREFUSED 10.2.165.226:9090 (#1034, #1087, #1173). template-svc kept logging healthy GC and never reported a crash (#1036, #1086), so the configured endpoint is wrong rather than the service being down. Refused connections fail fast, and notification-svc returns 503 upstream, which api-gateway surfaces on POST /v1/notify (#1113, #1182, #1289, #1364). Those gateway 5xx are downstream symptoms. The legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts in status-poller (#284 onward) are a separate deprecated-endpoint issue and do not explain the notify outage. No release appears in the window, so the config change is the trigger.
Alternative reading: template-svc is unreachable or hung. But the failures are immediate connection refusals rather than timeouts, and template-svc keeps logging, which argues against a hang.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back notification-svc config to the revision before 485, or correct TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to template-svc's actual listening address and port (the value in revision 485 resolves to 10.2.165.226:9090, which refuses connections). Then confirm render calls succeed and POST /v1/notify success recovers. Separately, retire the legacy-inventory healthcheck in status-poller, which still targets a deprecated endpoint.
